run_calculate_correctness_scores: run the script to calculate annotation correctness scores from a JSON annotation file
calculate_scores_function: calculate task and evaluation correctness scores for PrediViz annotations from a dictionary
display_scores_function: display computed annotation scores including task and eval correctness percentages to stdout
summarize_calculate_scores: summarize the calculate_scores function that computes frame and episode level correctness metrics
review_display_scores: review the display_scores function that prints annotation summary and top failure remarks
